summary: Iter18 major-refactor testing (owner role + Pengrajin CRUD + SPK allocations + BM/Progres per pengrajin). Backend 34/34 pytest passing. Frontend smoke tests pass for all critical flows: admin/owner sidebars, owner read-only enforcement, Pengrajin CRUD dialog, Database Barang without pengrajin fields, SPK/BM/Progres pages load.

minor.issue: POST does NOT implement per-pengrajin pipeline validation — it uses aggregate _get_stage_sums() / _get_qty_masuk() ignoring the pengrajin_id. Only PUT /api/progres/{id} does the per-pengrajin validation (line 1170-1172). Also POST does not persist pengrajin_id in the doc (line 1116-1128) whereas PUT does (line 1211). Inconsistent — may lead to progres entries per-po/barang but not per-pengrajin. This means the requirement 'Progres per pengrajin — POST /api/progres validates pipeline per (po,barang,pengrajin)' is NOT met for the create path.

class ProgresEntry (line 319) does not declare pengrajin_id field, but code at line 1168 references entry.pengrajin_id. This works only in the PUT handler which sets 'pengrajin_id = entry.pengrajin_id or ""' — Pydantic v2 will raise AttributeError if payload contains pengrajin_id since default extra='ignore' drops unknown attrs and the attribute is not defined. In practice PUT succeeded in isolated testing likely because the attribute access defaults via BaseModel __getattr__ path — but this is fragile. Recommend adding pengrajin_id: Optional[str] = None to ProgresEntry.

Owner POST /spk returns 403 correctly, but with an EMPTY items list (as in my test payload) the SPK write path also short-circuits — however with items[] = [] it must still pass Pydantic validation. Confirmed 403 is returned correctly. No fix needed; just note that role check happens after pydantic validation, so bad payloads yield 422 before RBAC 403.

ui_bugs.issue: Page fires GET /api/users → 403 for owner (owner is not allowed to list users). Non-blocking but produces two console errors and 'Failed to load users' toast/log. Owner should not trigger the users fetch.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing aria-describedby / DialogDescription in some dialogs — accessibility a11y warning in console. Not blocking.
